new_trends.query: European data center real estate investment 2026
new_trends.trend_summary: Data centers have emerged as a major institutional European real estate asset class, driven by AI demand: EUR 176bn in cumulative investment is forecast between 2026 and 2031, vacancy is falling toward a record 6.5% by the close of 2026, and the sector captured 31% of global real estate fundraising in the nine months to September 2025.
citations: European Data Centre Association via Data Center Knowledge, 2026-02-09
Colliers Global Investor Outlook 2026 via Urbanitae, 2025-12-09

known_theme_checks.explanation: European real estate investment reached EUR 116 billion in H1 2026, up 10% year-on-year, per CBRE (Source: CBRE — European Real Estate Investment Figures H1 2026, 2026-07-30). Capital flows have broadened beyond hotels/offices in London/Paris: living accounted for 26% of H1 investment, and Spain saw investment up 59% YoY.
The ECB reversed into a hiking cycle in June 2026 (Source: European Central Bank, 2026-06-11), directly contradicting the original easing thesis.
